about: Mothlamp news, read by Mothy (the desk moth). Newest items can go anywhere in the list; each id must be unique and never reused. Mothy only shows items dated within three weeks of when it was installed.

items.title: CHAINBLOOM's free demo is out
items.text: One tap, and everything blooms. All eight nights, every jar and every rare are in the demo, plus a new Daily Bloom jar every day. Plays in your browser.

items.title: PORCHLIGHT's free demo is out
items.text: Something happened at the porch light. Work out who was where. Tonight's Case is free every night, and the demo has the first six nights of Case Files.
